facts.assertion: Enfield Council reported on 15 June 2026 that the Planning Inspector had issued a post-hearing letter on the Local Plan.
Enfield says the Inspector's post-hearing letter sets out further Main Modifications or steps required to make the Local Plan sound and legally compliant.
Enfield formally withdrew from the government's New Town programme on 28 May 2026.
The withdrawal announcement states the Council would no longer support New Town proposals linked to Crews Hill, Vicarage Farm and parts of the borough's Green Belt.
A council withdrawal from the New Town programme is classified separately from formal Local Plan adoption or an authoritative candidate parcel geometry decision.
Lambeth's later 24 March 2026 housing update describes Leigham Court Road as a 92-home scheme expected to start construction in 2026-2027.
Lambeth's earlier 19 November 2025 approval announcement had estimated Leigham Court Road construction would begin in early 2026.
For current programme timing, the March 2026 Lambeth update is treated as later evidence than the November 2025 estimate; neither timing statement proves candidate 61522 parcel membership.

Havering LDO0001.26 records Consultation Closed for the data-centre-campus proposal; that status is not treated as candidate 46142 approval or Local Plan allocation.
